# require2DArray

<link-summary>Returns the value as a non-empty two-dimensional array, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>require2DArray() — Returns the value as a non-empty two-dimensional array, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/array</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function require2DArray<T>(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Expected a non-empty two-dimensional array."
): T[][];
```

The check to put in front of `Range#setValues`, which rejects a flat array with a message that names neither the
argument nor the reason. `require2DArray` throws first, with a message you control, and returns the value so the
call composes into an expression.

It accepts exactly what [`is2DArray`](is2DArray.md) accepts: a non-empty array whose every element is an array. Rows
of differing length pass — use [`requireConsistent2DArray`](requireConsistent2DArray.md) when they must match.

## Parameters

| Parameter                                                                | Type      | Description                                                                        |
| :----------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`                                                                  | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                                             |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Expected a non-empty two-dimensional array."` | `string`  | The exception message. Defaults to `"Expected a non-empty two-dimensional array."` |

## Returns

`T[][]` — the same value, typed as a two-dimensional array.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                                     |
| :------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | The value is not a non-empty array of arrays. |

## Examples

### Validating and using in one expression

<tabs group="code">
<tab title="TypeScript" group-key="ts">
<code-block lang="typescript" src="require2DArray.ts" include-symbol="writeRows"/>
</tab>
<tab title="JavaScript" group-key="js">
<code-block lang="javascript">
function writeRows(sheet, values) {
  const rows = require2DArray(values, "values must be a matrix of rows");
  sheet.getRange(1, 1, rows.length, rows[0].length).setValues(rows);
}
</code-block>
</tab>
</tabs>

### What passes and what throws

```javascript
require2DArray([
  [1, 2],
  [3, 4]
]); // => [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
require2DArray([1, 2]); // throws IllegalArgumentException
require2DArray([]); // throws IllegalArgumentException — no rows
```
